Zangoose

Normal

Hoenn · Generation 3

Zangoose is a Normal-type Cat Ferret Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1.3 m tall and weighs 40.3 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Attack (115), with a base stat total of 458.
